subject: Renewal & capacity increase — pricing options and co-term path
messages:
From: Ali Khan <ali.khan@novamed.ai>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal & capacity increase — request for pricing options

Hi Jasmine,

We're coming up on our annual renewal and are looking to increase committed capacity to support a new feature launch in H1 2027. Current snapshot: we have a hosted plan with a 10M token commit/month, average utilization around 65% with peak bursts. We expect to add roughly 40% more sustained throughput plus a short-term 2x burst window for 6-8 weeks.

Key asks:
- Options to co-term renewal to Jun 30, 2027 (align with our fiscal calendar)
- Pricing for +40% committed capacity and any volume discounts or tiering you can offer
- Whether Redwood can convert some short-term overage into a temporary accelerator credit vs. committed uplift
- Any support/package add-ons (priority support, onboarding assistance for a Dedicated pool) and the incremental cost

I've attached a high-level usage dump for Q3 and a short note from our engineering lead.

Thanks — can we get a ballpark by EOD Wednesday? We have procurement cycles to respect.

– Ali

[attachment: usage_Q3.csv (CSV)]

From: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Ali Khan <ali.khan@novamed.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity increase — request for pricing options

Hi Ali — thanks for the context and the usage file.

We can absolutely help structure a renewal that covers the +40% committed uplift and the short-term burst. Initial thoughts (ballpark):
- Co-term to 2027-06-30: yes — we can pro-rate the remaining term and annualize the new commit.
- Volume uplift: we typically provide tiered discounts starting at a 10% uplift for +25% commit, and stepped pricing beyond that. For +40% we can model a 12% list discount on the incremental capacity.
- Accelerator credit: for the 6–8 week burst we can offer a temporary accelerator credit (token credit) to smooth immediate overages; amount depends on confirmed burst window and acceptance of a 3–6 month ramp commitment.
- Dedicated + onboarding: Dedicated pools incur a one-time onboarding/validation fee; we can include 1 month of priority support as part of certain incentive packages.

I want to loop in Ben (AE) and Laura (CS lead) to pull together a concrete MAP and formal proposal. Ben — can you run a quick pricing sketch and indicate whether we should offer an extra incentive (credit or extended support) to close before EOD Friday? Laura — scope for Dedicated onboarding and whether we need any health checks prior to ramp?

Proposing a 30-minute call Wednesday 10:00am PT if that works.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132]

From: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>

Subject: Fwd: Renewal & capacity increase — request for pricing options

Ben/Laura — forwarding Ali's ask. Quick summary of the plan I sketched to him above.

Pricing ask: Novamed wants +40% committed tokens, co-term to 2027-06-30, and a 6–8 week 2x burst. They want ballpark by Wed EOD and procurement will push for a single consolidated invoice and discounted uplift.

Proposal I think will close:
- 12% discount on the incremental +40% commit if they sign on the co-term; convert remainder to annualized commit for the term to Jun 30, 2027.
- Offer an accelerator credit for up to 6 weeks equal to 20% of their expected burst overage (applied as token credit).
- Include 1 month of priority onboarding support for Dedicated (no charge) if they commit to trial Dedicated within 90 days.

I'm green to offer 12% but procurement will likely push — if we need to go to 15% we need pre-approval. Total ARR delta looks like ~$310k incremental for the remainder of the term (rough math attached).

Asks:
- Ben: can you prepare a formal proposal PDF + a MAP workbook by Wed?
- Laura: can you confirm onboarding cost and whether CS can do 1 month free priority support if they commit Dedicated?

Thanks — I can fast-track once we have internal approval for discount range.

– Jasmine

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal & capacity increase — request for pricing options

Thanks for the summary, Jasmine.

I'm ok to approve an offer with the following constraints:
- Discount cap at 12% on incremental capacity for this transaction; any higher (>=15%) requires Finance approval and an exception memo.
- Approve 1 month of priority onboarding support for Dedicated at no charge if they accept a Dedicated trial and sign the co-term.
- Accelerator credit can be up to 15% of estimated burst overage (not 20%) and should be time-boxed (max 6 weeks).
- We must record the MAP activities in HubSpot (deal noted) and include a 48-hour pricing hold window once the final proposal is shared.

I attached a short approval memo; Ben, please include the following in the proposal: co-term to 2027-06-30, incremental pricing table (list, discounted), accelerator credit language, and a DocuSign-ready amendment for a pro-rated term. If total contract value > $250k, route to Finance for sign-off.

– Laura

Hi Ali — appreciate the patience while we pulled internal approvals. Attached is our formal proposal and a MAP workbook that lays out milestones, responsibilities, and timelines. Highlights: 

- Co-term: Renewal aligned to 2027-06-30 with pro-rated conversion of the new commit for the term.
- Incremental capacity: +40% committed tokens with a 12% discount on the incremental capacity (per Laura's approval). Detailed table in the proposal (PDF).
- Accelerator credit: up to 15% token credit for up to 6 weeks to cover anticipated burst; credit applied to overage before billing.
- Dedicated/onboarding: we will include 1 month of priority onboarding support at no additional charge if NovaMed provisions a Dedicated trial within 90 days of signature.
- Pricing hold: this commercial term will be held for 48 hours from delivery of the proposal.

Next steps:
1) Review the attached Redwood_Proposal_NovaMed_v2.pdf and MAP_NovaMed.xlsx.
